issues.title: How big can an URI template be?
issues.author: aretana
issues.body:
> Question: how big can an URI template be?

I don't believe URI or URI templates specification define a ceiling.
Clearly, to reliably fit URI template into BGP UPDATE message it must be constrained to a reasonable length. How would you recommend defining it?

_Originally posted by @yaroslavros in https://github.com/yaroslavros/bgp-masque-tunnel/issues/1#issuecomment-4740186341_

comments.author: aretana
comments.body:
We need to check the bounds and add some text about the size of the BGP UPDATE message and the potential need to use extended messages.

This may be a good topic for Operational Considerations: if the template is too large, the tunnel won't be usable.

pulls.title: Initial review
pulls.author: aretana
pulls.body:
I took an initial look at the draft and made some changes:

- instead of indicating which sub-TLVs are not applicable, I changed the logic to list the ones that are (this should be easier to maintain)
- added some minor things to be compliant with what idr expects (https://wiki.ietf.org/group/idr/TEA-templates)
- added some validation text

I think we could publish this initial version, but I do want to go back for a deeper look into some things:

- look in detail at the allowed Sub-TLVs
- I didn't look into the URI Template or ALPN sub-TLVs
- The Operational and Security Considerations look good, but I want to think about them a little more

Question: how big can an URI template be?
